commitResults.messageBody: Highlight Active Students after adding a student

Describe index-based command behaviour precisely, simplify the add
syntax summary, and name the commands that operate on archived
students.

Add blank lines between descriptions, parameters, rules, and
examples so every command usage message follows the same layout.
Fix result panel and compact layout issues

commitResults.messageTitle: Show three lines of command feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
The result panel is 44 pixels high and shows only one line, so a
two-line message such as a rejected lesson time is cut off.

Raise the panel to 68 pixels and remove the extra top padding, so
that most messages fit without scrolling. Long usage messages still
scroll.

Fixes #179

commitResults.messageTitle: Lighten sidebar hover and command selection
commitResults.messageBody:
Sidebar buttons inherit the dark blue hover colour of ordinary
buttons, which makes their labels hard to read. The command box also
selects text in the same strong blue.

Give sidebar buttons light hover colours, and use light blue for the
selected text and focus border of the command box.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep student details readable in small windows
commitResults.messageBody:
Tags share a row with the student name, so several tags or one long
tag can hide the name. At the minimum window size, sidebar labels are
cut off, phone numbers split across lines, and the empty list message
is truncated. The default window size may also exceed a small screen.

Move tags to a wrapping row below the name, and limit the width of
long tags. Tighten the sidebar, index, and details spacing, wrap the
empty list message, and keep the opening size within the primary
screen. These changes support the layout checks in #119.

The guides show tags beside the student name and do not explain how
long values are displayed. The User Guide also says that `edit` keeps
Active Students highlighted, but `edit` keeps the current view.

Describe the result panel and card behaviour, correct the sidebar
description, add a manual test for the minimum window size, and
replace the main window screenshot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reduce the result panel to two lines
commitResults.messageBody:
A 68-pixel result panel leaves a large gap under one-line messages
such as the `list` confirmation, and it shortens the student list.

Set the panel to 52 pixels. Most messages fit at the default window
size, and longer messages scroll. Update the guides, the manual test,
and the main window screenshot to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Ignore line endings in theme layout tests
commitResults.messageBody:
The new layout tests search for multi-line text in the stylesheet, so
they fail on Windows, where Git checks files out with CRLF endings.

Normalize line endings when the tests read a resource, so that the
tests pass on every platform.

commitResults.messageTitle: Highlight Active Students after adding a student
commitResults.messageBody:
`add` shows all active students, but the sidebar keeps highlighting
the previous view, so Upcoming Lessons or Archived Students can stay
selected over the active list.

Select Active Students after a successful `add`. A rejected `add`
leaves the list unchanged, so its highlight stays the same.

Fixes #186

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep the restored window position on screen
commitResults.messageBody:
The saved window position is restored without checking that it is
still visible, so an edited preferences file or a disconnected
monitor can open the window off-screen.

Keep the restored position within the visible bounds of the screen
that holds it, or of the primary screen if no screen holds it. Use
that screen to limit the window size as well, so a window saved on a
larger external monitor keeps its size there.
Separate sections in long command usage messages
